content.value_statement: Proxmox clusters need regular checks across nodes, quorum, and shared resources. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured cluster reviews.
actual_capabilities: Lists Proxmox cluster nodes through the documented get_nodes tool.
Checks detailed node health through the documented get_node_status tool.
Reviews cluster-wide resources with the documented get_cluster_resources tool.
Guides cluster health, node monitoring, and capacity planning workflows.
Frames reports around quorum status, utilization, bottlenecks, and optimization recommendations.
limitations: Requires working Proxmox access through the underlying tools.
Does not apply repairs, migrations, or configuration changes by itself.
Depends on current cluster telemetry for accurate health and capacity conclusions.
Does not replace administrative review before maintenance or upgrade actions.

use_cases.title: Daily Cluster Health Review
use_cases.description: Check node status, cluster resources, and quorum before operational work begins.

use_cases.title: Capacity Planning Review
use_cases.description: Compare node utilization and identify resource bottlenecks before adding workloads.

use_cases.title: Maintenance Readiness Check
use_cases.description: Review node health and cluster balance before planned upgrades or maintenance windows.

prompt_templates.title: Check Cluster Status
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me the current status of all Proxmox cluster nodes and summarize any unhealthy conditions.

prompt_templates.title: Review Node Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: List the cluster nodes, check each node status, and identify CPU, memory, or storage pressure.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Cluster Capacity
prompt_templates.prompt: Review cluster resources and node metrics, then highlight bottlenecks that could affect new workloads.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Maintenance Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a maintenance readiness report with quorum status, degraded nodes, resource balance, and recommended precautions.

output_examples.input: Show me the status of all cluster nodes.
output_examples.output: A node-by-node health summary with online state, key utilization metrics, and a short list of issues needing attention.
A ranked capacity review that calls out pressure points, affected nodes, and practical next actions for workload placement.

output_examples.input: Get a complete cluster infrastructure report.
output_examples.output: A structured report covering cluster resources, quorum, node health, utilization trends, and optimization recommendations.

best_practices: Run cluster health checks before maintenance, upgrades, or workload placement.
Review quorum, node status, and resource utilization together for context.
Validate recommendations against current operational policies before taking action.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the report as permission to make production changes automatically.
Do not ignore offline nodes or quorum warnings during capacity planning.
Do not rely on stale telemetry when troubleshooting active incidents.

faq.question: What Proxmox information does this skill focus on?
faq.answer: It focuses on cluster nodes, node health, cluster resources, quorum, utilization, and capacity planning signals.

faq.question: Can it change my Proxmox configuration?
faq.answer: No. The skill describes monitoring and reporting workflows, not configuration changes or repair actions.

faq.question: Which tools does the skill reference?
faq.answer: It references get_nodes, get_node_status, and get_cluster_resources as the available Proxmox cluster tools.

faq.question: Is this useful for maintenance planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It helps review health, quorum, and resource balance before planned work.

faq.question: Does it diagnose capacity bottlenecks?
faq.answer: It helps identify likely bottlenecks from node metrics and cluster resource utilization.

faq.question: Does it require live cluster access?
faq.answer: Yes. Accurate results depend on the underlying tools being connected to current Proxmox data.
